spec: Card with no fill or shadow on a slightly tinted page: 1px line at 8-10% ink, radius 2-8, padding 32, 20/500 title, 16/24 muted copy, then one real object pinned to the base, such as a command field, sketch or logo, the only white thing in the row.

Text-only outline card: 1px line, radius 4-16, 16-28 padding, 12px mono or caps label, 16-20px title, one short muted line, no icon tile, no shadow. Keep it compact at about 160px tall. Hover darkens the border, not the fill. Suits docs indexes and capability lists.

Horizontal pointer card, full column width, 70-114px tall: 8px padding, 1px line, radius 12-16, 64-96px thumbnail at outer radius minus padding, 16px title, 14px accent action, 32px round arrow chip pinned bottom right, 16px gap between rows. Hover darkens only the border.

The card works as a picture mat: page one tone off card, radius 16, padding 8 all round, image radius 8-10 so corners nest, then 16-24px text inset. Byline row carries a 1px hairline leader between author and read time. Good for blogs and case studies with strong images.

Two nested layers: outer white card radius 16-24 with 1px line, inner tinted well inset 8px at outer radius minus 8, holding seals, a tick list or live component. Title row sits in the shell, proof sits in the well. Well gives a place for evidence without a second border weight.

No border, no shadow, one tone step off the page, about 2-5% lightness. Radius 8-32, padding 32-56. Title 20-32px light or medium, muted copy, one link. Depth comes from tone alone, so it stays calm at any size. Use warm greys on white, and steps of 6-10 on dark.

Card with copy top-left and a real interface fragment that starts about 48px in and runs past the right and bottom edges, rounded only at its one visible corner. Card clips it. Fragment must stay dense to the crop. Radius 12-32, 24-32 padding, 24px title. Never pad the fragment on all sides.

Pure image tile, radius 20-28, no border or shadow, phone or crop clipped by the tile. Caption sits outside on the page ground, inset about 15px from the tile edge, bold lead-in then muted sentence. Tiles run as a carousel with circular arrows. The picture stays uninterrupted.

Full-bleed photo tile, radius 0-12, 12-24px gaps, scrim only where text sits: a bottom gradient to 50-60% black or a side wash. 20-34px white title 24-40px in, round arrow bottom right. Better still, take the scrim colour from the image so the field looks native.

Image or colour band on top about 40-60% of height, tinted body below in a colour taken from the brand or image, radius 12-24, 20px gaps. 24px title, 16/27 copy, hairline and small mono label over the image. Row can bleed off the edge with the next card peeking.

Warm off-white tile with fine SVG noise at 30-45% multiply, radius 16-24, 1px ink line at 5%. Name top-left, price or prompt bottom-left, deliberately empty middle. One tile in a row may swap paper for a grainy colour mesh to mark the pick. Reads as a physical sample.

Card whose subject is a number. Plans: 20/500 name, 40/600 price, 12px tag, 13px note, ticks at 30px pitch, 36px full-width button. Proof: mono label, 48px figure, 18px caption low, faint texture in one corner. Numbers use tabular figures and align across the row.

Flat saturated or pastel cards, no border or shadow, radius 0-35, 16-48px gaps. Each card owns one fill and text is set in a dark tint of that fill rather than black. Three at most in a row, on a neutral or black ground. Use where the brand is colour-led.

Ordinary card with one owned edge: a chamfer cut across about 100-167px, a white circle biting a corner to hold a 46px arrow, a folded 32px corner, or a 3-8px coded top bar. Repeat the same edge on every card and clip so it becomes the site's shape.

White card, no visible border, radius 8-18, on a tinted ground, 24-56px padding, one soft tinted shadow around 0 6px 12px -2px at 15-25%. The default most sites overuse. Keep it for objects that really float or for a single featured card, and vary the height of one card to break the row.

Large section panel one tone off the page, radius 12-28, no border or shadow, 34-120px padding. Either one centred statement, or left copy with product UI bleeding off an edge. One grey carries the whole page, so warm it slightly. Usually 1024-1392px wide, inset 24px from the viewport.

One panel in the inverse of the page: white on near-black, or a deep colour on white. About 1020-1392px wide, radius 8-28, 24px from viewport edges, 460-630px tall, generous empty field around a 40-64px statement or a diagram. It becomes the brightest object on the page, so use once or twice.

Full-width brand colour slab with 12-36px margins and a large radius of 24-69px, breaking a white rhythm: 36-60px white heading left, UI or a white list card right. One per page. Radius this large needs a width over 1000px or it looks like a pill.

Sections are physical sheets: a next section with 24-40px top corners slides over the last, or rooms of colour with 32px radius are separated by 40px of page. Inner cards step down to 24px. Use a section colour drawn from that section's image. Works on phones unchanged.

The page sits inside a frame: a white or paper sheet inset 16-36px from the viewport over a brand colour or white desk, top radius 0-16, or a dark image window inset 16px with up to 120px top corners and a 2-3px pale rim. Colour survives as a thin gutter.

Dark shell radius 16 with 4px padding around panes radius 12, so panes share a gutter instead of borders. 44px title row with logo left and 12px muted context right. Inner radius always equals outer minus gap. Sits on a grainy plate with a 0 16px 40px -12px black shadow.

Single bordered panel, 1280 wide, 1px line, radius 8-16, split into 2-3 cells by shared single rules, no gaps. 40px padding: 16px title, 14px copy, link, then a visual filling the rest, and an optional centred pill at the foot. One object, several ideas.

Large neutral panel, radius 16-40, 1344-1400px wide, 20px gutter, 406-580px tall, with an oversized product render cropped by the panel and a white info card overlapping it at the same radius. Or a photo dissolving by gradient into a flat colour drawn from itself, with copy on the fade.

Panel outline carries the idea: white blocks notched into hero art on 12px gaps, a stepped or chamfered corner, a ~400px dome. Cut corners stay rounded by 4-12px at each join. Keep every other surface plain, and repeat the same cut on one more object so it reads as language.

Section presented as an app window: radius 12-20, soft 40px shadow, only two 14px hairline controls top right and no fake traffic lights, internal scroll, 8px inset from a 40px global bar. Enough chrome to sell the idea. Suits playful devtools; never for a serious finance page.

A small fixed object that hugs its content: 56px caption tray, 160px note, or 384px news card, 16-24px from viewport edges, radius 3-16, hairline plus soft 0 4px 24px shadow, close control included. It reads as a physical note, not a chat bubble. One per page, dismissible.

No fill or border: a statement framed only by four 1px L-brackets, 40px each arm, in the accent colour across about 1360x350. Centre 30/38 text at about 85% ink. The brackets do the work of a card while the page stays open. Works best on dark or technical pages.

Full-bleed band split 50/50 into two tints of one hue, 0 radius, flat. UI cards and devices straddle the seam and overlap the section above. Or columns of one template repeated in different hues. Colour does the layout, so keep type simple and shadows off.

A self-contained module inside a magazine grid, radius 0-8, 300px wide: caps title, thumbnail, status line and a full-width action in one accent colour, closed by a 4px rule. It behaves like a boxed feature in print, so it needs a dense surrounding grid to look at home.

Unloaded images hold their true aspect in flat ~#e9e9e9 blocks, no shimmer or icon, then fade in over 300ms. The layout never shifts during scroll. Quiet, and much more expensive-looking than a skeleton pulse. Give every image an explicit aspect-ratio.

Borderless tiles one tone off the page, radius 20-40, 16-24 gaps, no shadow. Rows use opposing splits such as 60/40 then 33/67. 24px title inset 32-40px with muted second phrase, no paragraph. Each tile holds different evidence: UI, seal, logos, number. Art runs off a corner.

Tiles with 1px line, radius 12-16, 12-24 gaps, on a 12-column grid: 2-up over 3-up, or one tall tile beside two short. White or warm tint, 24-32px inset, 18-24px title, key phrase in full ink and the rest muted. Tile edge crops the product. Optional 36px arrow top right.

Each tile is a shell plus well: 1px hairline shell radius 22, 8px padding, tinted well radius 14-16 holding a small white UI object, centred with air around it. Title and one muted line sit in the shell beneath. Rows alternate 2:1 and 1:2, 16px gaps. Keep the UI small.

One frame split by 1px rules instead of gaps: grid gap 1px on a line-coloured background, cells opaque. Outer radius 0-20, no cell fills, row heights 240 and 360 mixing 400/800 and 400/400/400. UI crops fade into the ground by mask. 18px title with arrow bottom-left.

Tiles of 584 and 280 wide, 418 tall, 24 gaps, radius 20-24, no border. Each tile has one vertical gradient or inner bloom, 30px padding, 20/600 title, 15/24 body, then a product fragment cropped by the bottom or right edge. Gradients come from one family. Rows mirror their spans.

Each tile owns one flat fill from a short family, radius 24-40, 8-50px gaps, widths deliberately unequal. 36-40px heading, one visual per tile, closing bar or arrow. Colour separates, so no borders or shadows. Keep the family tight: four steps of one temperature, not a rainbow.

Photo tiles and solid data tiles share one rhythm: same radius 24-40, same 16-20px gap, same title anchor at bottom-left 32px in. Dark-gradient photos alternate with flat brand fills, and figures sit in the solid tiles. Good for consumer, public and impact pages.

Charcoal tiles #1e1e1e, 20px radius, 1px #2c2c2c border, device and widget crops tilted about 6 degrees and bleeding past the base, one large tile with an accent edge glow. Tilt is the only flourish, so keep the type upright and caps titles at 24px.

Four 284px masonry columns, 16px gap, tinted note cards radius 20, 28px avatar, 14px name, 17/24 text, right-aligned grey counts, with long posts spanning two columns and images on top. Heights come from real content, so it never looks gridded. Good for community and social proof.

Nothing is rounded: images, cells, fields and buttons are all 0, with at most one round element such as a help button. Structure comes from rules, gutters and fill steps. Suits fashion, galleries, investors and editorial. Needs excellent photography and type, because nothing softens the page.

Two tight steps: 2 or 4px on controls and cards, up to 6-8px on large media, nothing higher. The corner is barely visible, yet it stops frames reading as raw rectangles. Feels like instruments and drafting. Good for finance, devtools and infrastructure.

Two radii with two meanings: containers small, 2-20, every interactive control a full pill. Shape alone says what is clickable, without colour. Pair 4 with pill for a sharp feel, 12 with pill for a soft one. Never round a container and square a button.

Inner radius equals outer radius minus the gap between them, at every level: 16/12 with a 4 gap, 25/15 with 10, 42/34 with 8, 30/25 with 5. When the gap reaches half the outer radius, floor at the next step of a fixed scale. Pills stay pills. Nothing sits between steps.

Radius assigned by role, with gaps between tiers: 40 section cards, 16 inner cards, 12 chips, 9999 buttons. Or 28 cards, 10 chips, full round on icons. Roughly halve each step with element size. Count how many radii the page uses: three plus pill is enough.

Radius doubles with element size: 16 tiles, 32 cards, 64 media, 128 wide panels, pill buttons, or 69 slabs with 42 wells. Huge panels still feel related to small tiles, and the curve becomes the brand shape. Needs wide elements and a friendly consumer tone.

Tiles are square at 0, and a wrapper clips the whole group at radius 30 with overflow hidden, so four images read as one object. A 4px page-colour gap acts as a thin cross. Inner corners stay sharp. Good for galleries of equal images.

All structure by 1px lines at 7-10% ink, no shadows on page elements, so depth belongs only to product UI inside mock-ups. On pure black tint the line cool, about rgba(214,235,253,.19) on r8. Requires a precise grid: every line is visible, so every misalignment is too.

Two 1px verticals run the full page at the container edges, inverting across dark and light sections. Horizontal rules snap onto them with ~6px hollow square nodes, and overshoot 40-48px past the frame, fading out. Every section reads as cut from one sheet. Strong devtool signature.

Frame implied by corners only: ~12px L ticks 1-3px thick, ~12px outlined squares, or detached 1px rails sitting 16px off the tile and never meeting. Reads as print crop marks. Apply to section containers, never inner cells. Works with a muted tint per section.

Dark card, radius 24, 1px cool line at 15-19%, plus a second 1px line just inside the top edge running the middle 50%, brightest at centre and fading both ways, and a faint radial glow below it. One light source for every card. Hover can slide the highlight.

Highlight the chosen plan with the same card and a 1px accent keyline at 40-50%, a 4px accent halo at 8-10%, and the only filled button in the row. No scale-up, ribbon or fill change. A variant fades the 2px outline from transparent at the top to strongest at the base.

Two lines around one object: a 2px outer line, ~4px paper gap and 1px inner line for a printed menu feel, or a solid 1px inner with a dashed outer offset ~5px to mark a selected object. Or a 1px rectangle offset 14px behind a photo. Use on few, chosen objects.

Line style carries data. Solid hairlines for the core product and 1px dashed cells for the paid tier, or green borders for paths and grey for utilities. Readers learn the code without a legend. Limit to two styles and keep both at the same weight and alpha.

An almost invisible outer rim around a lifted inner panel: outer radius 25, 1px line at 6-10%, 10px padding, inner fill one step up at radius 15. Or a solid 8px pale ring around dark media, outer 42, inner 34. The rim sets the object apart with no shadow.

Panels interlock like puzzle pieces: a stair-step bite of about 65px rise and 220px run from a corner, every join rounded at 12px, and a separate patch fills the bite leaving a 12px page channel. Repeat one angle or step on buttons and tags.

The browser window itself is framed: a fixed 1px rule 22px in with a tiled ground outside, content scrolling inside; or a 10px brand strip across the very top with no header bar. Strong concept. Suits one expressive brand and needs a real reason.

1px rule at about 10% ink, content width and never full bleed, 80px clear above and below, on a single background. Rules do all the section pacing. Use the same line for index rows at a narrower width, and a final full-ink rule to mark the end of content.

Faint 1px rule, 6-10% ink, runs edge to edge between sections with 64px padding either side and no colour bands. The page feels ruled rather than boxed. Suits fashion, galleries and research sites where images supply the interest.

2px solid ink rule across the full content width, about 8px under a 15px label, used as the only divider on the page. Its weight closes a section the way a magazine rule does. A variant runs the first 62% solid and the rest at 20%, like a progress marker.

Two line types with two jobs. Solid 1px for structure, and round 1px dots about 6px apart for rows, breaking at column gutters. Or solid under H2 and dashed under H3. Draw dots with a radial gradient, because CSS dotted spacing cannot be set.

List row with a 1px hairline stretching across free space between title and meta, like a contents page: flex-1 leader, 42px row height, 12-15px text, right-aligned tag and date. The leader carries the eye 800px across. Darken it on hover instead of filling the row.

One 1px vertical at about 6% white runs the feed at the rail's left edge, ~7px dots marking each date. Newest dot in the only colour on the page chrome, older dots dim. Content sits in a separate column about 320px right. Made for changelogs.

Section label as a ~53px strip between two 1px rules: 13px bold label left, 13px muted date right, no large heading. Or a brand stripe of two 8px bars with a 4px gap, used exactly once. Rules and one bold word do the work of a headline.

Sections meet along a shape rather than a line: a straight 6 degree slant, a ~1200px flat ellipse tinted 2%, a ~150px corner tab, or one SVG torn edge. Echo a shape already in the hero. Use once or repeat exactly, and keep it quiet in colour.

Instead of a rule, small marks: two 12px L ticks opening a section, a ~44px band of 1px ticks at uneven 14-27px spacing, or a 30px arrowhead on a grid corner. Barely visible, and they add a measuring-instrument tone. One device only.
A single full-bleed deep colour band interrupts a white shelf to promote one thing: 18px headline left, image bleeding off the bottom right. Used once. Works because everything around it is uniform.

Two layers per level: a hue-tinted layer 0 30px 60px -12px at 25% and a black layer 0 18px 36px -18px at 30%. Blur is twice y, and spread pulls in so nothing leaks past the top. Scale y 2, 6, 13, 30, 50. For a contact-only look set spread to minus y.

Three layers with three jobs: 0 0 0 .5-1px ring at 10-13% draws the edge, 0 1px 1px at 4-7% makes contact, 0 2px 4px at 4% or 0 14px 34px -10px at 18% lifts. Tint the colour with the page's ink. Replaces the border, and stays crisp on any ground.

Solid duplicate with no blur, offset down and right: 3-6px on small items, 12-24px on large panels, 1px outline on the object, 0 radius or a small one. Reserve it for few key objects. Every other surface stays flat, which is what makes this one lift. Has a printed feel.

A huge faint halo: blur about 120px at 3-4%, gone 70px past the edge, plus a tight 0 2px 16px contact, or 0 10px 40px at 6-10% tinted by the ground. It washes into the page and is only just perceptible. Good on one hero object on a pale ground. Multiple blooms turn to fog.

Base frames carry no shadow at all. Only objects in motion or fixed above the page do: a caption tray at 0 4px 24px 10%, a rising clip visible 40px past its edges. A shadow therefore means this layer moves, so the page reads as flat until it matters.

Depth by overlap instead of shadow: a white sheet with 16px top radius slides over the last section while that section dims from #eaeaea to #d1d1d1. Or a section ends in 60px bottom corners with a soft tinted shadow on a pale layer. The page behaves like stacked sheets.

Sheets tilted about 2 degrees with a second sheet offset behind, heading and body rotating with the card so it reads as a physical object. ~24px radius, no blur shadow. Reserve for a single playful moment on a consumer page. Never tilt a card that holds a form.

Sticky bar over scrolling content: blur 12-20px, fill 62-72% of the page colour, 1px line. Blur must be strong enough that large headings passing beneath turn to soft smears, otherwise type collides with the links. This is where nearly all real glass lives.

Same bar shape, two skins. Over light content it is light glass. Over a dark section or footer it flips to translucent near-black with a 1px white 10% ring, white links and a light CTA with a dark label. Detect by scroll position, not blend modes.

No bar background at all. Each nav group gets its own ~16px blur patch with ~40px feathered edges, or the top 76px blurs through a gradient mask, so cards melt out under the logo. Content stays sharp between groups. Build with mask-image on a backdrop-filter layer.

Small caption tray over changing media: rgba(255,255,255,.5) with blur ~20px, radius 3-6, width hugging the text. It turns olive over lime and pale cyan over cyan, so it belongs to each image. Text stays dark with a 58% second line, since blur removes the detail that hurts reading.

Cards over a single close photograph: white at 7-20%, blur, radius ~24, 12px pill tags, hairline, 28px title. The photo tints them, so colour comes from the image. Needs a dark or mid-tone photo and a row that bleeds off the right edge.

Large panel, 1040-1160px, radius 12-28, measured fill only 30% near-white with heavy 30-40px blur and a 1px line, over one object that crosses its edge: a ribbon dissolves beneath it and turns crisp past the border. That crossing is what shows the glass. Over a smooth gradient, nothing shows.

Small frosted card straddling the edge of a photo: 273x198 translucent cream, radius ~12, or a 632px panel overlapping a corner by ~210px at 60% dark. Half on image, half on page, so the blur is visible and the text stays readable. Use once beside large imagery.
